title: Resolve linked worktrees to the main worktree's ledger when the project declares it
description: Agents running in linked Git worktrees discover the worktree's own tracked copy of .waystation/ and write claims, messages and status changes into a branch-local snapshot that other agents never see. WAYSTATION_ROOT fixes this but is opt-in per agent and fails silently when forgotten. Add a project-level config setting git.ledger_root ("checkout" default | "main_worktree"). When upward discovery finds a ledger whose config declares main_worktree and the discovered directory is a linked worktree, resolve to the main worktree's ledger instead. --root and WAYSTATION_ROOT still take precedence. A missing main-worktree ledger or a bare repository is a ledger_not_found error, never a fallback to the branch-local copy. Record the decision in an ADR that amends ADR-0003.
acceptance: resolveLedgerRoot redirects a linked worktree to the main worktree's ledger only when the discovered config declares git.ledger_root = main_worktree.
Default (no setting or "checkout") behavior is unchanged; --root and WAYSTATION_ROOT still win.
A declared redirect whose main worktree has no ledger, or whose repository is bare, fails with LedgerResolutionError rather than falling back.
Tests cover redirect, default, precedence and failure cases with a real git worktree fixture.
An ADR amending ADR-0003 records the decision; README and docs/mcp.md describe the setting.
bun test, typecheck, biome check and waystation validate are clean.
notes: Follow-up guard against leaking branch-local ledger snapshots into merges: task-guard-branch-ledger-commits.
